component.name: Easy Player
component.summary: Play a song, then the rest of its folder

description.p: Easy Player is a small audio player. Drop songs or folders on the window, or double-click a song in the file manager, and it plays.
One button brings in the other songs from the playing song's folder, in folder order around it, so an album carries on from the song you opened.

ul.li: Plays MP3, FLAC, Ogg Vorbis, WAV, AAC/M4A, AIFF and more
Keyboard media keys and the desktop's media controls (MPRIS)
A song opened from the file manager goes to an idle window, or a new one
One player plays at a time: starting a song pauses the others
